primary_root_cause: Damaged or disconnected wheel-speed-sensor wiring or connector
other_likely_causes: Corroded or water-contaminated sensor connector or terminals
Harness chafing near the fork, swingarm, or wheel causing an intermittent short
recommended_first_check: Disconnect the affected front (C1032) or rear (C1034) wheel-speed-sensor connector and inspect the lead and terminals, then check the sensor circuit for continuity and shorts while flexing the harness.
reasoning: The code is set when the ABS module sees an open, short-to-ground, short-to-voltage, or electrically failed wheel-speed-sensor circuit. Harness damage and connector faults are more common than an ABS module fault, especially where the sensor lead moves with suspension or steering; ABS is disabled while the fault is active.
